sn11.19:1.2: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave sakko devānamindo mātalisaṅgāhakaṃ āmantesi:
sn11.19:1.3: yojehi samma mātali, sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ. uyyānabhūmiṃ gacchāma subhūmiṃ dassanāyāti.
sn11.19:1.4: evaṃ bhaddantavāti kho bhikkhave mātalisaṅgāhako sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā sakkassa devānamindassa paṭivedesi:
sn11.19:1.5: yutto kho te mārisa, sahassayutto ājaññaratho
sn11.19:1.7: atha kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo vejayantapāsādā orohanto pañjaliko sudaṃ bhagavantaṃ namassati.
sn11.19:1.8: atha kho bhikkhave mātalisaṅgāhako sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
